notes: Statement: IATI 2021 senior day 2 task 1 (Hint), arena.olimpiici.com problem 1603 (PDF); it has no sample test. Grader-only (genHint and solve in separate processes), stdio-adapted through interactor.py: round 1 gets the local grader's input (N M, A, B, K, an optimal C) and prints the hint bits, round 2 gets A, B and the hint and prints an LCS, checked for length K and for being common; one process serves both rounds, so state kept across them is not caught. No accepted submission exists (the four C++ ones crash), so orig.cpp sends N bits marking C's leftmost embedding in A: correct, but far over the 640 bits that score fully. gen.py's C is Hunt-Szymanski, checked against the O(NM) DP on 400 generated cases.
